newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens int'l sales drive 1H 96/97 growth.
newsitem.headline: Siemens int'l sales drive 1H 96/97 growth.

text.p: Germany's Siemens AG said on Wednesday strong international growth in the first half of 1996/97, especially in the Americas and in Asia, more than offset weakness in Germany and Europe.
First-half international orders rose 20 percent to 35.7 billion marks, with two percentage points of the increase coming from exchange rate fluctuations, the comapny said.
International sales climbed in the first half 11 percent to 28.2 billion marks, while German sales fell two percent to 16.5 billion marks.
North and south American orders rose 35 percent to 10.8 billion marks, as orders in the United States rose 18 percent ot 6.8 billion marks.
In the Asia/Pacific region, first-half orders increased 28 percent to 7.3 billion marks, helped by a series of large telecommunications contracts.
First-half German orders declined three percent to 18.2 billion marks, while orders in other European countries edged up five percent to 14.5 billion marks.
